releaseNotesDesc: Bona okusha engxenyeni yakamuva ye Novera.

interface.title: Isixhumi sokuxhumana
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Lapho izaziso zivele khona. KwiWindows, okuzenzakalelayo kusezwa kwesokudla phansi ukuze ama-popups angafaki ulawulo lwewindow.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Khombisa amathokheni/ngesekhondi kanye nenani lamathokheni ngaphansi kwemiyalezo yosizo. Uma icishiwe, isithonjana esifushane sibonisa imininingwane uma uchofoza.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Sebenzisa umbala wokugqamisa njengemvelaphi yemiyalezo yakho. Uma icishiwe, ihambisana nemiyalezo yosizo enombhalo ohlukile ngemuva elinjengejwayelekile.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Faka ithebhu ye-Preview kumabhulokhi wekhodi ye-HTML ne-SVG. HTML isebenzisa ikhasi elenziwe yimodeli kufreyimu evikelekile eliqhuba amaskripthi alo kodwa lingakwazi ukufinyelela ku-Novera, amafayela akho, noma inethiwekhi; i-SVG idweba ngendlela yesimanje ngaphandle kwamaskripthi. Icimiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Fingqa ngokuzenzakalelayo izingxoxo ezintsha zibe isihloko sengxoxo. Kucishiwe ukuze ugcine isihloko esizenzakalelayo kuze kube usiguqula wena.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Setha umbala wangemuva wendawo enkulu yokuqukethwe.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Beka kabusha zonke izilungiselelo ze-interface ku-default.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Khetha indlela i-chat viewport okufanele iphendule ngayo lapho imiyalezo emisha ifika.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Igcina i-viewport inamathele emyalezweni wakamuva othunyelwe.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Ilandela ngokuzenzakalelayo njengoba izimpendulo zifika ngesikhathi sangempela.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Khombisa ikhowntha yezimake ngaphakathi kokungenisa impendulo yengxoxo. Uma ikhubazekile, ikhowntha yezimake ivele ngaphansi kokungenisa.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Bonisa izinombolo zemigqa ngaphakathi kwamabhulokhi ekhodi.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Setha kabusha isitayela sebhulokhi yekhodi sifinyelele kokungokwesizinda.

hardware.name: Igama
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Sebenzisa Vulkan API ukuze usheshise GPU. Ungavuli Vulkan uma unayo NVIDIA GPU ngoba kungabangela izinkinga zokuhambisana.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Ayikho ama-GPU abonakalayo kwi-enjini llama.cpp. Amamodeli azosebenza ku-CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: Indlela i-llama.cpp ekhuluma ngayo nalo GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: I-GPU yabelana ngophahla olulodwa lwememori ne-CPU — amamodeli adonsa kwimemori efanayo nezinye zehlelo.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: Ama-GPU akho ashintshile, ngakho-ke i-enjini yendawo yaphinde yasetshenziswa. Amamodeli azulayishwa ngokuzayo.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: Ama-GPU akho ashintshile, kodwa imodeli isibandakanyekile. Yiyeke, bese ucindezela Buyekeza ukuze usebenzise i-GPU entsha.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: I-URL kanye ne-port yeseva yakho ye-proxy.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Uhlu oluhlukaniswe ngesikhamulo lwemibhalo ongagqiba khona i-proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Vumela izitifiketi ezizisayinile noma ezingaqinisekisiwe. Lokhu kungadingeka kwezinye i-proxy kodwa kwehlisa ukuphepha. Yenza kuphela uma wethemba i-proxy yakho.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Qinisekisa isitifiketi se-SSL lapho uxhuma ku-proxy.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Qinisekisa izitifiketi ze-SSL zezimoto eziya endaweni.

webSearch.title: Ukusesha Kuwebhu
webSearch.description: Vumela amamodeli ukuthi afune futhi afunde kwiwebhu usebenzisa amathuluzi akhelwe ngaphakathi e-Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Khuthaza amathuluzi e-web_search kanye ne-web_fetch kumamodeli asebenzisa amathuluzi. Kusebenza ngokushesha ngaphandle kokhiye we-API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Khetha i-backend ephendula web_search kanye ne-web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Uyazikhethela. Nikeza ukhiye we-{{provider}} API ukuze uthole izilinganiso eziphezulu nemiphumela ehlelekile. Shiya ingenalutho ukuze usebenzise i-endpoint yamahhala ngaphandle kukhiye.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Kuyadingeka. {{provider}} idinga ukhiye we-API ukuze ibuyise imiphumela.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Kuyadingeka. I-URL ewisisekelo ye-instance yakho ye-{{provider}}, enokhiye we-JSON API uvuliwe.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Lungisa indawo yomsebenzi we-ejenti Cowork: isikhumba sayo esivikelekile, kanye nezikhumbuzo namakhono agcinwa unomphelo kufolda yakho yedatha Novera.
cowork.shellChecking: Ukuhlola ukuthi kukhona yini indawo evikelekile...
cowork.shellSandboxed: Imiyalo eqhutshwa ngaphansi kuka {{backend}}: ingabhala kuphela ngaphakathi kwemisebenzi yeseshini, futhi amafayela akwifolda yakho yasekhaya awafundiwe.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Akukho ndawo evikelekile etholakalayo kulesi simiso, ngakho ithuluzi lesikhumba alinikezwanga. Imiyalo ayiqhutshwa ngaphandle kokuvikelwa.
cowork.networkDesc: Vumela imiyalo ka Cowork ukufinyelela inethiwekhi, ngezinto ezifana nokufaka amaphakheji noma ukuthola i-repository. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Isikhumba segxoxo enkulu asihlali sinesikhathi sokufinyelela inethiwekhi.
cowork.noMemories: Akukakhumbuleki lutho okwamanje. Amamodeli awengeza ngosizo lwethuluzi memory_write lapho efunda izinto ezifanele ukugcinwa.
cowork.noSkills: Awukho amakhono okwamanje. Ikhono liyisethi yemiyalelo engasetshenziswa kabusha engalayishwa yimodeli uma kudingeka.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Isihloko esisodwa ngenothi. Izibonelo zifunda lokhu kusetshenziswa ithuluzi memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Imiyalelo Markdown, ngokuzikhethela nencazelo ku-YAML frontmatter. Incazelo yilokho okubonwa yimodeli ngaphambi kokulayisha ikhono.

localApiServer.title: Iseva Yendawo API
localApiServer.description: Sebenzisa iseva ehambisanayo ne-OpenAI endaweni yakho.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Buka ama-log alandelayo anemininingwane yeseva yasekhaya ye-API.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Qalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo i-Local API Server lapho uhlelo luqala.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Gcina iseva isebenza ku-system tray lapho iwindi livaliwe. Uma ivaliwe, ukuvala iwindi kuyayeka Novera bese kumisa iseva.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Ama-host avunyelwe ukufinyelela iseva, ahlukaniswe ngekama.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Vumela izicelo ezivela kwezinye izindawo ku-server ye-API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Vula amarekhodi we-server anezincazelo eziningi ukuze uthole izinkinga.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Isikhathi sokulinda impendulo kumodeli yasendaweni, imizuzwana.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Imodeli yasendaweni ezolayishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho i-server iqala.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Ukuze usisize sithuthukise Novera, ungabelana ngedatha engaziwa njengokusetshenziswa kwezici nezinombolo zabasebenzisi. Asisoqoqi izingxoxo zakho noma ulwazi lwakho siqu.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Unawo wonke amandla ngedatha yakho. Funda kabanzi kuMthetho Wethu Wobumfihlo.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Ukuze sithuthukise Novera, sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi isetshenziswa kanjani—kodwa kuphela ngosizo lwakho. Ungashintsha lesi silungiselelo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
privacy.privacyPromises: Ukukhetha kwakho lapha ngeke kushintshe izithembiso zethu eziyisisekelo zobumfihlo:
privacy.promise1: Ingxoxo zakho ziyimfihlo futhi zisekhaya lakho idivayisi
privacy.promise2: Asisoze siqoqa imininingwane yakho siqu noma okuqukethwe kwezingxoxo
privacy.promise3: Yonke ukwabelana ngedatha kuyimfihlo futhi kuhlanganisiwe
privacy.promise4: Ungakhetha ukuphuma noma yinini ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa umsebenzi
privacy.promise5: Sicacisa ngakho konke esikuqoqa futhi sizokutshela ukuthi kungani

attachments.subtitle: Hlela iziqeshana zemininingwane, imikhawulo yosayizi, nokuziphatha kokuthola imininingwane.
attachments.enableDesc: Vumela ukulayisha nokuhlela imibhalo ukuze uthole imininingwane.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Khetha indlela imibhalo ehlaziya ngayo eyengezwa ezingxoxweni.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Ingxenye yomongo wemodeli esetshenziselwa ukuvala ukufakwa kwemafayela abhalwe kahle kumamodeli endawo.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Vula i-Enable Attachments ukuze ushintshe umkhawulo wosayizi wombhalo.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Usayizi omkhulu kuwo wonke umbhalo. Kuqinisekiswa ngesikhathi sokulayisha nokuqhuba. Izithombe zinesilinganiso sazo esingenhla.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Usayizi omkhulu kwesithombe ngasinye (JPEG noma PNG). Umhlinzeki wakho noma imodeli ingase ibeke umkhawulo ophansi.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Isilinganiso esincane sokufana (0-1). Sisetyenziswa kuphela ekusesheni kwe-linear cosine, hhayi ku-ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Khetha phakathi kwe-sqlite-vec ANN, i-linear cosine, noma i-auto.
